title: Expose canonical source scopes in JSON v2 for shared watcher routing
outcome: Serve scope roots from Engram's existing committed-input reader and switch the Engram launcher to the exact v2 contract in one coordinated cutover.
acceptance: `engram source --root ABS --json` emits only the agreed JSON v2 envelope with exactly version,status,root,source,tree,entries,refusal,scopes; source observation remains store-independent and existing verdict/entry/refusal/exit semantics are preserved.

Supported clean/not_clean scopes contain the canonical root first and every descendant accepted from the same recursive submodule result, lossless UTF-8 and plain Windows paths, unique canonical directories with descendants sorted by serialized UTF-8 bytes; linked roots/children work without new Git queries, topology probes, traversal, or file/index census.

Unknown, malformed, ambiguous, duplicate, missing or unrepresentable scope resolution fails closed; unavailable carries source/tree null and empty entries/scopes. Scope construction and final serialization share the existing <=8s or caller-shorter deadline and 1MiB JSON bound, with no partial result.

The Engram launcher validates and consumes exactly v2 at every owner capture without v1 fallback, opt-in flag or copied predicate; it retains current binary selection, authority, artifact, registration and separate fingerprint behavior.

The shared 24 verdict fixtures and representative linked-root/child, canonical alias/duplicate, non-ASCII order, missing/non-UTF8 resolution, malformed/partial adapter, JSON overflow and deadline cases pass with the agreed scope shapes; applicable focused checks, required whole-input review pair and standard FULL pass on the exact candidate.

Landing is coordinated after TermAl stage 1 lands and Fable2 confirms stage 2 can consume v2, with Windows B and Mac pins refreshed at the atomic cutover; active consumers never encounter an unprepared owner version. Existing evaluations and durable records are unchanged.
disposal_reason: v2 scopes dropped: Greg removed watcher events from EO credit (Asistant #390); TermAl no longer needs scopes and v1 stays. Both coordinators withdrew v2 (Engram Fable #1200, TermAl Fable2 #6745). Candidate a9019bdc remains unlanded. Cancellation resumed explicitly by Fable #1210 after the global pause.
